title: An inspection rated school restrooms and fountains fair. The public report card said good.

beats.text: In fiscal 2023 San Francisco school auditors asked for an inspection record.

visual.sub: The district could not locate an earlier inspection

beats.text: The district could not locate the form behind the Asawa school report card.

visual.kicker: The district could not locate an earlier inspection

beats.text: That left the published ratings at Asawa unverified.

visual.kicker: The district could not locate an earlier inspection

beats.text: The fiscal 2024 audit marked the records response implemented.

visual.kicker: The following audit marked the retention response implemented

beats.text: At a different school, auditors later identified a discrepancy.

visual.kicker: The following audit marked the retention response implemented

beats.text: One of 24 school sites tested had a rating mismatch.
At Independence High the inspector rated restrooms and fountains fair.

visual.kicker: Independence reported good where the inspector recorded fair

beats.text: The public report card shows good for the same category.
The auditors thought a clerical error was likely.

visual.kicker: Independence reported good where the inspector recorded fair

beats.text: The district agreed to check the inspector’s form against its summary.

visual.kicker: A later report used a different inspection

beats.text: The next public card also said good, using a fall 2025 inspection.

visual.kicker: A later report used a different inspection

beats.text: That later rating cannot verify a correction to the earlier report.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
